# Contributing

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Python | 3.7–3.9 (see `tox.ini`) | 3.7+ required; 2.7 is no longer tested in CI |
| pip | Latest | Used for installing dev dependencies |
| tox | Latest | Required for multi-version test matrix |
| flake8 | pinned in `requirements.txt` | Linting |
| black | Latest | Code formatting |

No Docker, no Node.js, no additional service dependencies.

## Getting Started

```bash
# Clone and install dev dependencies
git clone git@github.com:contentful/rich-text-renderer.py.git
cd rich-text-renderer.py
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Run tests
python runtests.py

# Run tests across all supported Python versions
tox
```

## Development Workflow

This is a single-package library. The dev loop is: edit source in `rich_text_renderer/`, run tests, lint, format.

```bash
# Run tests with the default Python interpreter
make test                  # source: Makefile → test target

# Format code
make format                # source: Makefile → format target (runs black)

# Lint
make lint                  # source: Makefile → lint target (runs flake8)

# Run coverage (also runs format + lint)
make coverage              # source: Makefile → coverage target

# Watch for changes and re-run coverage automatically
make watch                 # source: Makefile → watch target (requires fswatch)
```

## Testing

- **Framework:** Python `unittest`
- **Location:** `tests/` — one test file per source module (e.g., `tests/block_renderers_test.py`)
- **Run all:** `python runtests.py` or `make test` (source: `Makefile → test`)
- **Run single:** `python -m pytest tests/rich_text_renderer_test.py` (if pytest installed) or `python -m unittest tests.rich_text_renderer_test`
- **Watch mode:** `make watch` (source: `Makefile → watch`; requires `fswatch`)
- **Cross-version matrix:** `make test-all` or `tox` — runs against Python 3.7, 3.8, 3.9 (source: `tox.ini`)

No snapshot tests. No integration tests against a live Contentful API. All tests use fixture JSON documents.

## Commands Reference

| Command | What it does | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `python runtests.py` | Run all tests with default Python | `runtests.py` |
| `make test` | Run tests via `python setup.py test` | `Makefile → test` |
| `make test-all` | Run tests across all tox envs | `Makefile → test-all` |
| `tox` | Multi-Python version test run | `tox.ini` |
| `make lint` | Lint with flake8 | `Makefile → lint` |
| `make format` | Format with black | `Makefile → format` |
| `make coverage` | Format + lint + coverage report | `Makefile → coverage` |
| `make clean` | Remove build/test artifacts | `Makefile → clean` |
| `make dist` | Build sdist and bdist_wheel | `Makefile → dist` |
| `python setup.py publish` | Build + upload to PyPI + tag | `setup.py → publish` |

## Code Style & Conventions

- **Line length:** max 100 characters (source: `tox.ini [flake8]`)
- **Formatting:** `black` — run `make format` before committing
- **Linting:** `flake8` — run `make lint`; config in `tox.ini [flake8]`
- **Python 2/3 compat:** `from __future__ import unicode_literals` is present in all source files (legacy guard — Python 2.7 is no longer in CI but kept for compatibility)
- **Renderer structure:** Each renderer class is a thin wrapper with a `render(self, node)` method. New renderers should extend `BaseNodeRenderer` or `BaseBlockRenderer`, not duplicate dispatch logic.

## Commit Convention

No enforced commit linting (no commitlint or pre-commit hook). Historically uses free-form messages. Suggested style:

```
type: short description
```

Examples from git history: `fix: handle edge case`, `chore: update dependencies`, `feat: add table support`

## Branch Strategy

- `master` — default branch; represents the latest published state
- Feature branches — short-lived, merged via PR
- No explicit branch naming convention enforced

## Release Process

Releases are manual:

```bash
python setup.py publish
```

This builds, uploads to PyPI via Twine, and creates+pushes a git tag. Requires PyPI credentials configured for Twine. Version is managed in `rich_text_renderer/__init__.py` (`__version__`).

**Bump version in `__init__.py` before running publish.**

## Pull Requests

- No PR title format enforced (no branch protection rules visible in CI config)
- Required checks: CircleCI `test` job across Python 3.7, 3.8, 3.9
- Merge strategy: merge commit (observed from git history)
- Code owners: `@contentful/team-developer-experience` (source: `.github/CODEOWNERS`)

## CI/CD

| Job | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| CircleCI `test` matrix | Push / PR to `master` | Runs `python runtests.py` on Python 3.7, 3.8, 3.9 (source: `.circleci/config.yml`) |
| CodeQL Actions scan | Push / PR to `master` on `.github/workflows/**` | Scans GitHub Actions workflow files for security issues (source: `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`) |

## Sensitive Files & Generated Artifacts

| Path | Notes |
|---|---|
| `dist/` | Build artifacts from `make dist` — do not commit |
| `*.egg-info/` | Generated by setuptools — do not commit |
| `.tox/` | tox virtual envs — do not commit |
| `htmlcov/` | Coverage HTML report — do not commit |
| `docs/` | Generated Sphinx docs (if built via `make docs`) — not currently committed |
| `rich_text_renderer/__init__.py` | Version, author, email source of truth — update here before releases |
